summary: Frontend-only test of admin text inputs, run with Playwright at 1920 as admin+clerk_test (signed in with a Clerk ticket). Main Page Settings: I tested all 13 fields: site_name, tagline, address, mobile, whatsapp, support_email, support_text textarea, social youtube/facebook/instagram/twitter, upi_id, upi_name. Each one passed select-all+Delete to clear, fast keyboard.type of a multi-character string, Backspace x3, paste via insert_text, jumping to Home and typing in the middle, and Home+Delete. The full value was correct every time. Focus stayed on the same field, and no field had lost focus, reverted, jumped the cursor or failed to clear after a 1s idle. Placeholders show 'e.g. ...' in light italic (rgb(203,213,225)), so empty fields clearly look empty. Save showed a toast and persisted everything after a reload. Social links without a scheme were saved as https://... The footer picked up the new tagline, address, support text, mobile, email, social links and the site_name in the copyright line. Plans & Offers dialog: plan-name, price, duration, the features textarea with Enter newlines, offer switch, offer-price and offer-label all typed correctly. Create showed the card and saved features split into 3 lines in the DB. Edit pre-filled the values and saving the changed name and price persisted. Delete removed the card. Users search (admin-user-search-input) kept focus, filtered to the creator and cleared correctly. No page errors.

issues: Logo.jsx hardcodes 'CreatorLive24/7', so a changed site_name only shows in the footer copyright line and not in the navbar or footer logo. Only matters if the admin expects the brand name itself to change.
placeholder:text-slate-300 on white has very low contrast (about 1.5:1). This is intentionally faint, but slate-400 would still be clearly distinct and more readable.

action_items: Optional: let Logo use settings.site_name (or document that it is fixed).
Optional: basic validation or hints for the mobile/WhatsApp/email fields. They accept any text, e.g. the WhatsApp link becomes wa.me/<digits extracted>.
Remove admin+clerk_test@example.com from ADMIN_EMAILS before production.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings: Field and Section are defined at module scope and inp() is a plain function, not a component, so there is no remount on each keystroke. This is correct.
AdminSettings: useEffect only seeds f once (when !f), so a background loadSettings() won't overwrite what the user has typed. Good.
AdminPlans PlanForm: number inputs keep string state and convert with Number() on save. Clearing price gives Number('')=0 and saves 0 silently. Consider validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13/13 settings fields, 6/6 plan dialog fields, search input, save/persist/footer)
